name: Malta
headline: Malta: +4.7% growth in 2025, 2.4% inflation, debt 46% of GDP
sections: Malta is a $27.9 billion economy (2025), the world's 121st-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +4.7% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $72K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 5.3% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 2.4% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 6.1% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 3.0% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 8.4% (2025).
Gross government debt is 46% of GDP (2025), a moderate level. The general government balance is −2.2% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is +8.6% of GDP (2025), a large surplus. Trade equals 219% of GDP (2025), a highly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 51.7% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 44% of GDP by 2031, broadly stable from today's level. Life expectancy is 83.0 years (2024). Population: 574 thousand (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
